title: The Danube Shows Its Bones

mood.label: Wearing thin
mood.summary: A 42: the Hormuz standoff hardens and Brent tops $90 beside record markets, drones fly at Moscow, Europe's rivers run dry and Congo's Ebola outbreak is its largest ever — while Zambia's peaceful vote and a vast new ocean reserve hold the other end.

lines: They drew a line through Hormuz on a map
and called the water theirs by afternoon.
Brent went over ninety; the market held its records —
two truths standing in one room.
Six hundred drones went out toward Moscow,
the Danube shows its bones in the heat.
sixty-eight in Flores under the street.
the weave still holds, but the light comes through.
an ocean got its keepers back:
that's the thread we're holding to.
